package postgres

import (
	"context"
	"errors"
	"fmt"
	"time"

	"github.com/bemulima/ms-go-teacher-agent/internal/domain"
	"github.com/bemulima/ms-go-teacher-agent/internal/domain/repository"
	"github.com/jackc/pgx/v5"
	"github.com/jackc/pgx/v5/pgconn"
	"github.com/jackc/pgx/v5/pgxpool"
)

type TeacherOnboardingPathOutcomeRepository struct{ Pool *pgxpool.Pool }

var _ repository.TeacherOnboardingPathOutcomeStore = TeacherOnboardingPathOutcomeRepository{}
var _ repository.TeacherOnboardingPathOutcomeProjectionReader = TeacherOnboardingPathOutcomeRepository{}

const deliveredTeacherOnboardingPathOutcomeForSessionSQL = `
SELECT outcome.status,outcome.dialog_message_id::text
FROM teacher_onboarding_path_outcome_inbox AS outcome
JOIN teacher_onboarding_plan_handoff AS handoff
  ON handoff.planner_handoff_id=outcome.handoff_id
 AND handoff.student_id=outcome.student_id
 AND handoff.personal_teacher_id=outcome.personal_teacher_id
 AND handoff.dialog_id=outcome.dialog_id
 AND handoff.command_teacher_job_id=outcome.teacher_job_id
WHERE outcome.student_id=$1
  AND outcome.personal_teacher_id=$2
  AND outcome.dialog_id=$3
  AND handoff.state_ref_kind=$4
  AND handoff.state_ref_version=$5
  AND outcome.status IN ('PATH_READY','ACTIVE_PATH_EXISTS')
  AND outcome.dialog_message_id IS NOT NULL
  AND outcome.delivered_at IS NOT NULL
ORDER BY outcome.delivered_at DESC,outcome.event_id DESC
LIMIT 1`

func (store TeacherOnboardingPathOutcomeRepository) FindDeliveredForSession(ctx context.Context, studentID, personalTeacherID, dialogID string, stateRef domain.TeacherStudentReadinessStateRef) (domain.TeacherOnboardingPathOutcomeMarker, bool, error) {
	stateRef, err := domain.NormalizeTeacherStudentReadinessStateRef(stateRef)
	if err != nil || store.Pool == nil || !validUUIDString(studentID) || !validUUIDString(personalTeacherID) || !validUUIDString(dialogID) {
		return domain.TeacherOnboardingPathOutcomeMarker{}, false, domain.ErrInvalidTeacherOnboarding
	}
	var status domain.TeacherOnboardingPathOutcomeMarkerStatus
	var messageID string
	err = store.Pool.QueryRow(ctx, deliveredTeacherOnboardingPathOutcomeForSessionSQL,
		studentID, personalTeacherID, dialogID, stateRef.Kind, stateRef.Version).Scan(&status, &messageID)
	if errors.Is(err, pgx.ErrNoRows) {
		return domain.TeacherOnboardingPathOutcomeMarker{}, false, nil
	}
	if err != nil {
		return domain.TeacherOnboardingPathOutcomeMarker{}, false, err
	}
	marker, err := domain.NormalizeTeacherOnboardingPathOutcomeMarker(domain.TeacherOnboardingPathOutcomeMarker{
		Kind: domain.TeacherOnboardingPathOutcomeMarkerKind, Status: status, DialogMessageID: messageID,
	})
	return marker, err == nil, err
}

func (store TeacherOnboardingPathOutcomeRepository) Accept(ctx context.Context, input domain.TeacherOnboardingPathOutcomeRecord) (domain.TeacherOnboardingPathOutcomeRecord, bool, error) {
	normalized, err := domain.NormalizeTeacherOnboardingPathOutcomeRecord(input)
	if err != nil || normalized.DeliveredAt != nil || store.Pool == nil {
		if err != nil {
			return domain.TeacherOnboardingPathOutcomeRecord{}, false, err
		}
		return domain.TeacherOnboardingPathOutcomeRecord{}, false, errors.New("teacher onboarding path outcome repository pool is required")
	}
	command, err := store.Pool.Exec(ctx, `
INSERT INTO teacher_onboarding_path_outcome_inbox (
 event_id,execution_id,handoff_id,student_id,dialog_id,teacher_job_id,status,
 course_id,learning_path_id,first_lesson_id,personal_teacher_id,body,occurred_at,accepted_at
) VALUES ($1,$2,$3,$4,$5,$6,$7,NULLIF($8,'')::uuid,NULLIF($9,'')::uuid,NULLIF($10,'')::uuid,$11,$12,$13,$14)
ON CONFLICT (event_id) DO NOTHING
`, normalized.Outcome.EventID, normalized.Outcome.ExecutionID, normalized.Outcome.HandoffID,
		normalized.Outcome.StudentID, normalized.Outcome.DialogID, normalized.Outcome.TeacherJobID,
		normalized.Outcome.Status, normalized.Outcome.CourseID, normalized.Outcome.LearningPathID,
		normalized.Outcome.FirstLessonID, normalized.PersonalTeacherID, normalized.Body,
		normalized.Outcome.OccurredAt, normalized.AcceptedAt)
	if err != nil {
		if isTeacherOnboardingPathOutcomeExecutionConflict(err) {
			stored, readErr := store.getByExecutionID(ctx, normalized.Outcome.ExecutionID)
			if readErr != nil {
				return domain.TeacherOnboardingPathOutcomeRecord{}, false, readErr
			}
			return domain.TeacherOnboardingPathOutcomeRecord{}, false, conflictingTeacherOnboardingPathOutcomeReplay(stored, normalized)
		}
		return domain.TeacherOnboardingPathOutcomeRecord{}, false, err
	}
	stored, err := store.get(ctx, normalized.Outcome.EventID)
	if err != nil {
		return domain.TeacherOnboardingPathOutcomeRecord{}, false, err
	}
	if !sameTeacherOnboardingPathOutcome(stored, normalized) {
		return domain.TeacherOnboardingPathOutcomeRecord{}, false, conflictingTeacherOnboardingPathOutcomeReplay(stored, normalized)
	}
	return stored, command.RowsAffected() == 1, nil
}

func (store TeacherOnboardingPathOutcomeRepository) MarkDelivered(ctx context.Context, eventID, messageID string, deliveredAt time.Time) error {
	if store.Pool == nil || !validUUIDString(eventID) || !validUUIDString(messageID) || deliveredAt.IsZero() {
		return domain.ErrInvalidTeacherOnboardingPathOutcome
	}
	command, err := store.Pool.Exec(ctx, `
UPDATE teacher_onboarding_path_outcome_inbox
SET dialog_message_id=$2,delivered_at=$3
WHERE event_id=$1 AND delivered_at IS NULL
`, eventID, messageID, deliveredAt.UTC())
	if err != nil {
		return err
	}
	if command.RowsAffected() == 1 {
		return nil
	}
	stored, err := store.get(ctx, eventID)
	if err != nil {
		return err
	}
	if stored.DeliveredAt != nil && stored.DialogMessageID == messageID {
		return nil
	}
	return errors.New("teacher onboarding path outcome delivery state conflict")
}

func (store TeacherOnboardingPathOutcomeRepository) get(ctx context.Context, eventID string) (domain.TeacherOnboardingPathOutcomeRecord, error) {
	return scanTeacherOnboardingPathOutcome(store.Pool.QueryRow(ctx, `
SELECT event_id::text,execution_id::text,handoff_id::text,student_id,dialog_id::text,teacher_job_id::text,status,
       COALESCE(course_id::text,''),COALESCE(learning_path_id::text,''),COALESCE(first_lesson_id::text,''),
       personal_teacher_id::text,body,occurred_at,accepted_at,COALESCE(dialog_message_id::text,''),delivered_at
FROM teacher_onboarding_path_outcome_inbox WHERE event_id=$1`, eventID))
}

func (store TeacherOnboardingPathOutcomeRepository) getByExecutionID(ctx context.Context, executionID string) (domain.TeacherOnboardingPathOutcomeRecord, error) {
	return scanTeacherOnboardingPathOutcome(store.Pool.QueryRow(ctx, `
SELECT event_id::text,execution_id::text,handoff_id::text,student_id,dialog_id::text,teacher_job_id::text,status,
       COALESCE(course_id::text,''),COALESCE(learning_path_id::text,''),COALESCE(first_lesson_id::text,''),
       personal_teacher_id::text,body,occurred_at,accepted_at,COALESCE(dialog_message_id::text,''),delivered_at
FROM teacher_onboarding_path_outcome_inbox WHERE execution_id=$1`, executionID))
}

func isTeacherOnboardingPathOutcomeExecutionConflict(err error) bool {
	var pgErr *pgconn.PgError
	return errors.As(err, &pgErr) && pgErr.Code == "23505" && pgErr.ConstraintName == "teacher_onboarding_path_outcome_inbox_execution_id_key"
}

func conflictingTeacherOnboardingPathOutcomeReplay(stored, received domain.TeacherOnboardingPathOutcomeRecord) error {
	if stored.Outcome.ExecutionID == received.Outcome.ExecutionID && stored.Outcome.EventID != received.Outcome.EventID {
		return fmt.Errorf("%w: execution_id is already bound to a different event_id", domain.ErrInvalidTeacherOnboardingPathOutcome)
	}
	return fmt.Errorf("%w: event_id replay does not match immutable outcome evidence", domain.ErrInvalidTeacherOnboardingPathOutcome)
}

type teacherOnboardingPathOutcomeRow interface{ Scan(...any) error }

func scanTeacherOnboardingPathOutcome(row teacherOnboardingPathOutcomeRow) (domain.TeacherOnboardingPathOutcomeRecord, error) {
	var record domain.TeacherOnboardingPathOutcomeRecord
	var deliveredAt *time.Time
	err := row.Scan(&record.Outcome.EventID, &record.Outcome.ExecutionID, &record.Outcome.HandoffID,
		&record.Outcome.StudentID, &record.Outcome.DialogID, &record.Outcome.TeacherJobID, &record.Outcome.Status,
		&record.Outcome.CourseID, &record.Outcome.LearningPathID, &record.Outcome.FirstLessonID,
		&record.PersonalTeacherID, &record.Body, &record.Outcome.OccurredAt, &record.AcceptedAt,
		&record.DialogMessageID, &deliveredAt)
	if err != nil {
		return domain.TeacherOnboardingPathOutcomeRecord{}, err
	}
	record.Outcome.EventType = domain.TeacherOnboardingPathOutcomeSubject
	record.Outcome.CorrelationID = ""
	record.Outcome.CausationID = ""
	record.DeliveredAt = deliveredAt
	if record.Outcome.ExecutionID != "" {
		record.Outcome.CorrelationID = record.Outcome.ExecutionID
	}
	if record.Outcome.HandoffID != "" {
		record.Outcome.CausationID = record.Outcome.HandoffID
	}
	return domain.NormalizeTeacherOnboardingPathOutcomeRecord(record)
}

func sameTeacherOnboardingPathOutcome(left, right domain.TeacherOnboardingPathOutcomeRecord) bool {
	return left.Outcome.EventID == right.Outcome.EventID && left.Outcome.ExecutionID == right.Outcome.ExecutionID &&
		left.Outcome.HandoffID == right.Outcome.HandoffID && left.Outcome.StudentID == right.Outcome.StudentID &&
		left.Outcome.DialogID == right.Outcome.DialogID && left.Outcome.TeacherJobID == right.Outcome.TeacherJobID &&
		left.Outcome.Status == right.Outcome.Status && left.Outcome.CourseID == right.Outcome.CourseID &&
		left.Outcome.LearningPathID == right.Outcome.LearningPathID && left.Outcome.FirstLessonID == right.Outcome.FirstLessonID &&
		left.PersonalTeacherID == right.PersonalTeacherID && left.Body == right.Body &&
		left.Outcome.OccurredAt.Equal(right.Outcome.OccurredAt)
}
